QUOTE: "`LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788-800`) passes the empty result through. It returns empty when no tokenizer is wired, with no log."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper passes through the empty result from a failed tokenization, and that it also returns empty when no tokenizer is wired. So the same empty value covers both cases.
